subject: I wasn't going to send this confession about SoulPlan
preview_text: This changes how you think about date planning forever. And I almost kept it to myself.
body_paragraphs: I was looking at the data this morning. Not the good kind. The kind that shows me which couples stop using SoulPlan after a few weeks. And I realized something that made my stomach drop. It's my fault. Not the app's. Mine.

I don't usually write emails like this, but I built this app because my own relationship was falling into the 'what do you want to do tonight?' 'I don't know, what do you want to do?' black hole. The silence. The slow fade of excitement. I thought I was building a tool to fix that. But the data shows the couples who succeed with SoulPlan do one thing differently. They don't just browse. They commit.

They use the Surprise Date Planner feature. Not once. Not as a novelty. They make it a ritual. One person plans, the other gets surprised. Every week. Or every other week. The couples who do this? They're the 92%. The ones who tell us it changed their relationship. They stopped negotiating date nights and started creating them.

Open the app right now. Tap the Surprise Planner. Pick a date this week. Hit 'I'll Plan It.' Don't overthink it. The magic isn't in the perfect plan. It's in the act of planning for them. P.S. The most successful couples I've seen? They plan the surprise date for the same night every week. It becomes sacred. Try it once. Just once. Then tell me I'm wrong.
